verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party language SDKs. Developers instead get a documented REST API with key-based auth, rate limits and error handling, a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec intended for generating clients, and an official Terraform provider. Building against incident.io therefore works through generated or hand-rolled clients rather than official SDKs. missing for 10: official maintained SDK libraries (e.g. Python/TypeScript/Go), SDK docs and examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK/codegen use.
